Definition: Hoshajah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hoshaiah = "Jehovah as saved"; 1) a prince of Judah who assisted in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; 2) the father of Jezaniah (or Azariah) who was a man of note after the destruction of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar in the time of Jeremiah
